questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you to move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It warns drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road with traffic moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You may see this sign at intersections where U-turns would create conflicts with oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be prepared to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate work zone activity. When you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead, and you must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always indicates a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit for this road. You can drive slower than the posted limit if road conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is illegal and unsafe to make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look both ways before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means you must yield to other traffic. Slow down and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one is present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that other vehicles may be joining your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle sign with black lettering indicates a no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-way, two-lane roads to mark areas where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Get ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead. You will need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round warning signs are used only for railroad crossings. Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other services nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead such as curves, steep downgrades, or other dangerous conditions that need your attention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Some slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, farm equipment, or horse-drawn vehicles display this emblem. It warns other drivers that the vehicle will only travel at 25 mph or slower.
